# Interactive charts

Interactive charts of Python (zoom, pan, hover) are shown in the **Browser view**
of Bio7 when a chunk runs in the editor (▶ Run). When the document is rendered,
they are embedded in the HTML document. A chart is shown with its `show()`
method, with `bio7.show_html(chart)` or as the last expression of a chunk.

Each section needs its package (install it with *Python Packages*): plotly,
altair, bokeh, folium, hvplot (with holoviews). A chunk of a package which is
not installed shows the hint how to install it (`error=TRUE`: the document is
rendered anyway). The charts load their
JavaScript libraries from the internet (a CDN).

```{python data}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

rng = np.random.default_rng(3)
n = 200
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "length": rng.normal(10, 2, n),
    "width": rng.normal(4, 1, n),
    "group": rng.choice(["A", "B", "C"], n),
})
df["weight"] = 0.8 * df["length"] * df["width"] + rng.normal(0, 3, n)
df.head()
```

## plotly

```{python plotly, error=TRUE}
import plotly.express as px

fig = px.scatter(df, x="length", y="weight", color="group", size="width",
                 hover_data=["width"], title="Weight by length (plotly)")
fig.show()
```

```{python plotly-3d, error=TRUE}
px.scatter_3d(df, x="length", y="width", z="weight", color="group",
              title="Three dimensions (rotate with the mouse)")
```

## altair (Vega-Lite)

A selection in the left chart filters the right one.

```{python altair, error=TRUE}
import altair as alt

brush = alt.selection_interval()
points = alt.Chart(df).mark_point().encode(
    x="length", y="weight",
    color=alt.condition(brush, "group", alt.value("lightgray"))
).add_params(brush).properties(width=320, height=260)
bars = alt.Chart(df).mark_bar().encode(
    x="count()", y="group", color="group"
).transform_filter(brush).properties(width=320, height=260)
points | bars
```

## bokeh

```{python bokeh, error=TRUE}
from bokeh.plotting import figure, show
from bokeh.models import HoverTool

p = figure(title="Weight by width (bokeh)", width=640, height=380, tools="pan,wheel_zoom,box_zoom,reset")
colors = {"A": "#1f77b4", "B": "#ff7f0e", "C": "#2ca02c"}
for g, d in df.groupby("group"):
    p.scatter(d["width"], d["weight"], size=7, alpha=0.7, color=colors[g], legend_label=g)
p.add_tools(HoverTool(tooltips=[("width", "@x{0.0}"), ("weight", "@y{0.0}")]))
show(p)
```

## folium (Leaflet maps)

```{python folium, error=TRUE}
import folium

m = folium.Map(location=[47.66, 9.18], zoom_start=10)
sites = {"Konstanz": (47.66, 9.18), "Friedrichshafen": (47.65, 9.48), "Bregenz": (47.50, 9.75)}
for name, (lat, lon) in sites.items():
    folium.CircleMarker([lat, lon], radius=8, popup=name, color="crimson", fill=True).add_to(m)
m
```

## hvplot (holoviews)

The pandas DataFrame plots with `hvplot` (bokeh in the browser).

```{python hvplot, error=TRUE}
import hvplot.pandas  # adds df.hvplot

df.hvplot.scatter(x="length", y="weight", by="group", width=640, height=380,
                  title="Weight by length (hvplot)")
```
